built_in_firmware_assists: Default BIOS strategy clears cart authentication bit; instruction hook writes GPU auth magic and injects boot stub/trampoline/TOC. These are emulator interventions, not source firmware proof.
scope: Original full-core emulation after ordinary libretro content load; included BIOS, private empty system/save dirs, documented normal frontend input. HLE boot bypasses real firmware and cannot prove authenticated boot.

ordinary_Deck_input_trial.scope: Ordinary keypad1,release,B+C,release,U,U+L,release,0,release after fresh outdoor route. No guest code/RAM/CPU/task state injection or extra selector patch.

C_CPU_backend.scope: Retained native emulator CPU/GPU/DSP/IRQ execute the derived disc,including compiled native68000routine1AC68. No host source-instruction processor replacements; read-only observer chains the original reference callback.

original_frontend_audio_capture.scope: Original-core frontend callbacks; emulator-declared rate, not physical timing or reconstructed-C playback.
